css_rules.#timer: float: right; margin-right: 15px; font-size: 15px; color: #222; font-family: verdana;

sectional_time_locking.lock_behavior: Sections have fixed sectional timers (e.g. 20 minutes / 1200 seconds per section). User cannot freely switch to other sections before time expires or user submits part via sendData(). Section tab clicks are intercepted/disabled or restricted.
sectional_time_locking.expiry_action: When totalTime hits 0, auto-submit triggers sendData(), which submits section part to /exams/tests/p/submittestpart.cgi and redirects to next section URL or summary.

entry_exit_interception.on_navigation: Triggered in displayQuestions(), displayQuestionsSave(), displayQuestionsMark(), pauseTest(), sendData()
algorithm: var curtime = { st: myDatep, end: myDate };

duration_calculation.explanation: Because time counts down from initial totalTime, the start timestamp (st) has higher remaining seconds than the exit timestamp (end). The difference exactly equals time spent in that visit.
